promises.quote: The Trust currently experiences a significant level of attendance in the Emergency Department from patients presenting with mental health problems or self-harm and as such is constantly seeking ways to improve the experience for these patients. promises.summary: Develop referral pathway for mental health inpatients to ED to reduce stress and improve safety
